monitors.name: Requirements drift monitor
monitors.what: Resyncs the source of record: each requirement has a passing test, code that carries the stated value, trace links and fresh simulation evidence.

last.summary: 5/5 requirements in sync, 0 drifted, 0 stale; 0 new issue(s), 0 resolved; 5 proposal(s)

findings.text: Proposed hazard (WO-102): Use-error overdose from a decimal or keypad slip (for example, 2.5 U entered as 25 U) that a higher single-bolus cap would accept without any check against the patient's own dosing

Proposed hazard (WO-305): Bigger damage from input errors: at a 25 U cap a decimal slip or extra digit (2.5 typed as 25) is no longer rejected, and the pump has no confirmation step or sanity check against

Proposed requirement (Fault-injection runner): Child, 80 g meal, dose typed 10x: 1 of 10 simulated runs leave the safe envelope (pump.c result: typo 32.0 U rejected, re-entered 3.2 U → BG < 54 at 4.8 h (nadir 39)) while every r

Proposed requirement (Fault-injection runner): Adolescent, 15 g snack, dose typed 10x: 2 of 10 simulated runs leave the safe envelope (pump.c result: typo 6.5 U delivered → BG < 54 at 2.3 h (nadir 17)) while every requirement t

Proposed requirement (Fault-injection runner): Adult boluses for 60 g, then skips the meal: 3 of 10 simulated runs leave the safe envelope (pump.c result: bolus 6.7 U → BG < 54 at 3.7 h (nadir 51)) while every requirement test
